question: What becomes possible beyond through abandoning both dharma and adharma?
premises: Dharma and adharma are paired opposites
Abandonment of both transcends their duality
The whole can be considered in relation to the beyond
inference: By abandoning both dharma and adharma, one moves toward what lies beyond them.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically incomplete and continues into the next verse
plain_english: And also, by abandoning both dharma and adharma, all is directed beyond.
